[#90DBFF[]]Vanilla Expansion (VE) 原版扩展[white[]]的个人向内容扩展附属
A personal content add-on for [#90DBFF[]]Vanilla Expansion[white[]] (VE)

[red[]]本模组以 VE 为软依赖，主要内容仅在同时启用 VE 时可用。
首次启用本模组时，可能会提示缺少前置模组，此时可以忽略，退出并重启游戏即可。
This mod treats VE as a soft dependency; its main content is only available when VE is also enabled.
When you first enable this mod, it may warn about missing prerequisites. You can ignore the warning and restart the game.[white[]]

本模组在 VE 本体基础上添加了一些实用内容，可能会降低游戏难度或影响平衡；建议在熟悉 VE 本体后再使用。
This mod adds some practical content on top of VE. It may reduce difficulty or affect balance, so it is recommended for players already familiar with VE.
